cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Retroactive Permission
cards.instruction: Get approval for something you have already done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. How do you feel about me inviting a few people to dinner?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. So standing guests would be more considerate?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Six. I've already invited them. Would borrowing enough chairs for everyone turn that into a yes?

mechanism: Treat a housemate's practical hosting objections as evidence of A's training, then make retroactive approval the next supposed lesson in welcoming guests.
confusable: Not simply pressuring agreement: each criticism must be appropriated as pupil progress and used to seek yes to already sent invitations.
comparison: Solvable seating for invited guests rather than removed garden structure.
seedUse: Retains two chairs/six invited/borrow seats bargain; makes mentor claims responsive to actual logistics.
